headlines.title: CrowdStrike Announces 2026 Customer and Partner Award Winners: The Leaders Securing the Front Lines of AI
headlines.summary: AUSTIN, Texas & LAS VEGAS, September 02, 2026--Fal.Con 2026 – CrowdStrike (NASDAQ: CRWD) today announced its 2026 customer and partner award winners at Fal.Con 2026, recognizing the customers and partners building with CrowdStrike to secure the front lines of AI.

headlines.title: Is CrowdStrike Holdings (CRWD) Trading At A Premium Or Priced For Perfection?
headlines.summary: CrowdStrike Holdings has delivered very strong share price gains over the last three years, yet current valuation checks flag the stock as expensive rather than a clear bargain. After such a sharp move, investors are weighing those past returns against what the present pricing implies for the next leg. The stock has returned about 420% over the past three years, which puts a lot of optimism into the current market value.

headlines.title: Wall Street panicked over AI. Then came an 8-figure cybersecurity twist
headlines.summary: An unreleased model wiped out billions in market value. Five months later, that same AI drove a record earnings beat.

headlines.title: CrowdStrike Brings the Falcon Platform to the Anthropic Claude Marketplace
headlines.summary: AUSTIN, Texas & LAS VEGAS, September 02, 2026--Fal.Con 2026--CrowdStrike (NASDAQ: CRWD) today announced the Falcon platform is coming to the Anthropic Claude Marketplace, giving Anthropic customers a new way to purchase CrowdStrike using a portion of their existing Anthropic commitments.

headlines.title: CrowdStrike’s AI Security Boom May Still Have Room to Run
headlines.summary: Wall Street experts believe that AI adoption continues to create a cybersecurity spending cycle, with companies increasingly needing to secure AI agents, applications, and cloud workloads. CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc.

description: CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. provides cybersecurity solutions in the United States and internationally. Its unified platform provides cloud-delivered protection of endpoints, cloud workloads, identity, and data through a software as a service (SaaS) subscription-based model. The company offers corporate endpoint and cloud workload security, managed security, security and vulnerability management, IT operations management, identity protection, threat intelligence, data protection, SaaS security posture management, and AI powered workflow automation, and securing generative AI workload services, as well as security orchestration, automation, and response; and security information and event management, and log management services. It primarily sells subscriptions to its Falcon platform and cloud modules. The company has a strategic alliance with Cognizant Technology Solutions Corporation to help enterprises secure artificial intelligence across its lifecycle, from the AI agents and models to the foundational infrastructure that supports the entire AI ecosystem and with Snowflake to bring AI-native security and enterprise data at scale. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Austin, Texas.
